stem: A bathtub contains some water when its tap is opened. The volume \(V(t)\), in liters, of water in the bathtub \(t\) seconds after the tap is opened is given by \(V(t) = 0.8t + 12\). How many minutes after the tap is opened will the bathtub contain 180 liters of water?
solution: Since \(t\) is in seconds, convert: \(\frac{210}{60} = 3.5\) minutes.
verify:
t = symbols('t')
sec = solve(Eq(Rational('0.8')*t + 12, 180), t)
assert sec == [210]
ans = Rational(sec[0], 60)
assert ans == Rational(7, 2)
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
